================================================================================
SECTION 1: CORE PRODUCT SPECIFICATIONS & TECHNICAL DATA
================================================================================

1. COMMERCIAL GRADE CASTOR OIL (NDEVOLEO™ COMM)
- CAS Number: 8001-79-4 | EINECS: 232-293-8 | HS Code: 1515.30.90
- Availability: Regular Commercial Supply
- Physical Form: Clear, viscous, pale yellowish liquid
- Free Fatty Acids (FFA): 1.00% – 2.00% Max (as Oleic)
- Acid Value: 2.0 – 4.0 mg KOH/g
- Moisture & Volatiles: 0.25% Max
- Insoluble Impurities: 0.02% Max
- Iodine Value (Wijs): 82 – 90 g I2/100g
- Saponification Value: 177 – 187 mg KOH/g
- Hydroxyl Value: 160 – 168 mg KOH/g
- Specific Gravity (at 25°C): 0.957 – 0.961 g/cm³
- Viscosity (Gardner-Holdt at 25°C): U – V (approx. 6.5 – 8.5 dPa·s)
- Primary Applications: Industrial lubricants, specialty grease manufacturing, alkyd resin synthesis, hydraulic fluids, textile auxiliaries, and chemical intermediates.

2. FIRST SPECIAL GRADE CASTOR OIL (FSG / BSS) (NDEVOLEO™ FSG)
- CAS Number: 8001-79-4 | EINECS: 232-293-8 | HS Code: 1515.30.90
- Availability: Regular Commercial Supply
- Physical Form: Pale yellow, clear, bright viscous liquid (refined & bleached)
- Free Fatty Acids (FFA): 0.50% Max (as Oleic)
- Acid Value: 1.0 mg KOH/g Max
- Color (Lovibond 5¼" Cell): 20.0 Yellow Max, 2.0 Red Max (Gardner Color <= 3)
- Moisture & Volatiles: 0.25% Max
- Insoluble Impurities: 0.02% Max
- Iodine Value (Wijs): 82 – 90 g I2/100g
- Saponification Value: 177 – 187 mg KOH/g
- Hydroxyl Value: 160 – 168 mg KOH/g
- Specific Gravity (at 25°C): 0.958 – 0.962 g/cm³
- Primary Applications: Polyurethane bio-polyols, coatings, high-performance polyamides (Nylon 11 / 610), pharmaceutical synthesis, and precision technical lubricants.

3. CASTOR CAKE (ORGANIC FERTILIZER & MANURE) (NDEVAGRO™ CAKE)
- CAS Number: 68187-58-6 | HS Code: 2306.90.17
- Availability: Regular Commercial Supply
- Physical Form: Coarse brown flakes / meal pellets
- Nitrogen (N): 4.50% – 5.50% Min
- Phosphorus (as P2O5): 1.00% – 1.80% Min
- Potassium (as K2O): 1.00% – 1.50% Min
- Organic Matter: 80.0% – 85.0% Min
- Moisture Content: 8.0% – 10.0% Max
- Residual Oil: 6.0% – 8.0% (expeller process)
- Agronomic Properties: Naturally contains ricin alkaloid which suppresses plant-parasitic root nematodes, termites, and white grubs. Slow-release organic nitrogen source for soil fertility.

4. HYDROGENATED CASTOR OIL (HCO / CASTOR WAX) (NDEVWAX™ HCO)
- CAS Number: 8001-78-3 | EINECS: 232-292-2 | HS Code: 1516.20.91
- Availability: Regular Commercial Supply
- Physical Form: Hard, brittle, off-white flakes or powder
- Melting / Dropping Point: 85.0°C – 88.0°C
- Acid Value: 2.0 – 3.0 mg KOH/g Max
- Iodine Value (Wijs): 2.0 – 4.0 g I2/100g Max (complete catalytic hydrogenation)
- Hydroxyl Value: 155 – 165 mg KOH/g
- Saponification Value: 176 – 186 mg KOH/g
- Color (Molten, Gardner): 3.0 Max
- Primary Applications: Thixotropic rheology modifier in architectural coatings, powder coatings, lithium-complex automotive greases, PVC processing lubricants, electrical potting compounds, and wax polish formulations.

5. RICINOLEIC ACID (NDEVACID™ RIC)
- CAS Number: 141-22-0 | EINECS: 205-470-2 | HS Code: 2918.19.90
- Availability: Regular Commercial Supply
- Chemical Formula: C18H34O3 (12-hydroxy-9-cis-octadecenoic acid)
- Physical Form: Viscous, clear, light yellow liquid
- Ricinoleic Acid Purity: 85.0% – 88.0% Min (via gas chromatography)
- Acid Value: 180 – 190 mg KOH/g
- Iodine Value: 82 – 90 g I2/100g
- Saponification Value: 182 – 192 mg KOH/g
- Hydroxyl Value: 155 – 165 mg KOH/g
- Moisture: 0.50% Max
- Primary Applications: Specialty ester synthesis, cutting fluid corrosion inhibitors, textile surfactants, personal care emulsifiers, and bio-intermediate (including developmental sebacic acid R&D).

6. 12-HYDROXYSTEARIC ACID (12-HSA) (NDEVACID™ 12-HSA)
- CAS Number: 106-14-9 | EINECS: 203-366-1 | HS Code: 2918.19.90
- Availability: Regular Commercial Supply
- Chemical Formula: C18H36O3 (12-hydroxyoctadecanoic acid)
- Physical Form: Off-white hard flakes or crystalline powder
- Melting / Dropping Point: 75.0°C – 78.0°C
- Acid Value: 175 Min mg KOH/g
- Iodine Value: 2.0 – 4.0 g I2/100g Max
- Hydroxyl Value: 155 – 165 mg KOH/g
- Saponification Value: 180 – 190 mg KOH/g
- Fatty Acid Purity (12-HSA): 85.0% Min
- Primary Applications: The global benchmark thickener for multipurpose and lithium complex greases; acrylic and epoxy coating rheology modifier; precursor for specialty cosmetic esters and plasticizers.

7. REFINED GLYCERIN 99.5% (NDEVGLY™ REF)
- CAS Number: 56-81-5 | EINECS: 200-289-5 | HS Code: 2905.45.00
- Availability: Regular Commercial Supply
- Physical Form: Clear, colorless, odorless, hygroscopic viscous liquid
- Glycerol Purity: 99.5% Min
- Specific Gravity (at 20°C): 1.261 g/cm³ Min
- Moisture Content: 0.5% Max
- Color (APHA / Hazen): 10 Max
- Heavy Metals: < 5 ppm
- Chlorides: < 10 ppm
- Primary Applications: Alkyd resin synthesis, polyurethane chain extension, polyether polyols, personal care formulations, excipient, and humectant.

================================================================================
SECTION 2: SPECIALTY CO-PRODUCTS & DEVELOPMENTAL PIPELINE
================================================================================

SPECIALTY GRADES (AVAILABLE ON TECHNICAL ENQUIRY):
- Cold Pressed Castor Oil (CAS 8001-79-4): Virgin expeller cold press, non-chemical extraction for cosmetics and pharmaceutical carrier oils.
- Castor Oil BP 93 (CAS 8001-79-4): Fully compliant with British Pharmacopoeia 1993 / EP / IP monograph standards.
- Pale Pressed Grade (PPG) (CAS 8001-79-4): Premium light-colored castor oil for pale stoving enamels and clear urethane resins.
- First Pressed Degummed (FPD) (CAS 8001-79-4): Primary press degummed industrial oil.
- High Protein Castor Meal (CAS 68424-10-2): De-oiled high-nitrogen meal (6.0%–7.0% N) for organic horticulture and tea plantations.
- Crude Glycerin 80% (CAS 56-81-5): Industrial-grade unrefined co-product stream.
- Sodium Sulphate Anhydrous (CAS 7757-82-6): 99.4% purity neutralized crystalline co-product for detergent builders and glass.

ADVANCED DERIVATIVES (UNDER R&D DEVELOPMENT):
- Sebacic Acid (CAS 111-20-6, under development): Pure C10 dicarboxylic acid for bio-based polyamides (Nylon 6.10, Nylon 10.10) and jet lubricant diesters.
- Dehydrated Castor Oil / DCO (CAS 64147-40-6, under development): Conjugated drying oil with 9,11-octadecadienoic acid structure for rapid drying architectural varnishes and printing inks.
- DCO Fatty Acid (CAS 61789-45-5, under development): Distilled conjugated fatty acid for stoving enamels and epoxy esters.
- Bio-Polyurethane Polyols (CAS 68442-88-6, under development): Modified bio-polyols with engineered hydroxyl functionality for rigid spray foams, flexible elastomers, and adhesives.
- Dioctyl Sebacate / DOS (CAS 122-62-3, under development): Low-temperature synthetic lubricating ester.
- Dibutyl Sebacate / DBS (CAS 109-43-3, under development): High-efficiency plasticizer for vinyl polymers and pharmaceutical film coatings.
- Lithium 12-Hydroxystearate (CAS 7620-77-1, under development): Pre-reacted metallic soap powder for direct grease manufacturing.
- Calcium 12-Hydroxystearate (CAS 3159-62-4, under development): Water-resistant metallic soap for marine greases and calcium-complex greases.
- Zinc Ricinoleate (CAS 13040-19-2, under development): Coordinated zinc active salt that chemically traps volatile mercaptans and amine malodors in personal care deodorants.
- Zinc Undecylenate (CAS 557-08-4, under development): Topical antifungal active for pharmaceuticals and footcare powders.
- Methyl Ricinoleate (CAS 141-24-2, under development): Fatty acid methyl ester for diesel fuel lubricity improvement and specialty synthesis.
- Methyl 12-Hydroxystearate (CAS 141-23-1, under development): Intermediate for synthetic waxes and lubricant additives.
- Blown Oxidized Castor Oil (CAS 68187-84-8, under development): Thermally blown viscous polymerized fluid for printing inks, lithographic varnishes, and rubber plasticizers.

================================================================================
SECTION 3: PACKAGING, LOGISTICS & EXPORT INFRASTRUCTURE
================================================================================

BULK PACKAGING FORMATS:
1. ISO Tank Containers: 20,000 to 24,000 liters / 20–24 MT bulk liquid deliveries for long-term contract industrial accounts.
2. Multilayer Flexitanks: 21,500 liters / 21.5 MT installed in 20-foot standard dry container (FCL), food-grade virgin polymer barrier.
3. Composite IBC Totes: 1,000 liter / 950–1,000 kg intermediate bulk containers with UN-certified HDPE inner bottle and galvanized steel cage.
4. Steel Drums: 200 kg net weight, 216.5 liter gross capacity, new tight-head unlined or epoxy-phenolic lined steel drums (80 drums per 20ft FCL = 16 MT).
5. Multi-Wall Paper Bags: 25 kg net weight, 3-ply kraft paper bags with internal polyethylene moisture-barrier liner, shrink-wrapped and palletized on heat-treated ISPM-15 wooden or plastic pallets.

PORT & EXPORT LOGISTICS:
- Facility Location: Village Sardarpura, Taluka Deodar, District Vav-Tharad, Gujarat.
- Proximity to Major Gulf of Kutch Ports:
  - Deendayal Port (Kandla / INIXY): Dedicated liquid bulk export terminal with shore storage tank access.
  - Mundra Port (APSEZ / INMUN): High-frequency automated container transshipment terminal for scheduled FCL shipments to Europe, the Americas, Middle East, and Asia.
- Export Document Pack Provided: Commercial Invoice, Packing List, Bill of Lading, Certificate of Origin (Chamber of Commerce), Non-GMO Declaration, Certificate of Analysis (COA) per production lot, Technical Data Sheet (TDS), Safety Data Sheet (SDS).
- Third-Party Inspection: Pre-shipment batch sampling, testing, and container stuffing inspection by SGS, Bureau Veritas, or Intertek arranged upon buyer request.

================================================================================
SECTION 4: QUALITY ASSURANCE & BUYER QUALIFICATION
================================================================================

- Quality Policy: Every dispatch is lot-controlled and backed by full traceability to expeller crushing and reaction logs.
- Analytical Laboratory Capabilities: Testing of Free Fatty Acids (FFA), Acid Value, Iodine Value, Hydroxyl Value, Saponification Value, Color (Lovibond / Gardner), Moisture (Karl Fischer / Oven), Specific Gravity, Melting / Dropping Point, and Gas Chromatography for fatty acid composition.
- Sample Availability: Commercial qualification samples (100ml to 1kg) available for formulation evaluation, grease testing, and laboratory trials.
